items.title: William "Ba Ba" Ridgley Interview, 1959-06-02
items.q: That was Chinese, no, Henry Zeno on drum. Tom Benton, banjo. Sam Dutre, clarinet. Celestine, cornet. George Foster, bass. William Ridley, trombone. Emma Barrett, piano.

ctx.x: That went to Fort Worth. Paul Barnes, saxophone. Chinese, drummer. John Marrero, banjo. Simon Marrero, bass. Celestine, cornet. William Ridgely, trombone. Emma Barrett, saxophone. Piano.
